I replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread. I can't confirm the Gate 34 claim. I found nothing about a Marlowe rollout or a Gate 34 site at Quarrendon Freight Lines in the public notes or in the channels Hollis belongs to, so I'm treating it as unverified.

The brain search ran keyword-only, so a note worded differently could have been missed.

I told Hollis that QFL is a North team account. Dana Okafor runs it, Thea Ramaswell is the customer contact, and Dana or Ilse Varga are the people who could confirm the site. I won't pass Gate 34 on as fact unless one of them does.

I didn't read #inc-qfl-sev1, because Hollis isn't a member of it.
